The six terms are exactly the off-diagonal terms of the product $(a+b+c)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right)$:

$$(a+b+c)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right) = \underbrace{\frac aa+\frac bb+\frac cc}_{=3} + \frac ab+\frac ac+\frac ba+\frac bc+\frac ca+\frac cb.$$

So the requested sum equals $(a+b+c)\left(\frac1a+\frac1b+\frac1c\right) - 3 = 26 \cdot 28 - 3 = 728 - 3 = 725$.

ANSWER: 725
